topic: Shipping policy and delivery time in Kerala
content: Free express shipping across Kerala on all orders above ₹999. Standard delivery inside Kerala takes 1 to 2 business days. Express same-day or next-day delivery is available for Kochi, Calicut, and Trivandrum.
Orders outside Kerala are delivered within 3 to 5 business days. Free shipping applies on orders above ₹1,499.
Once your order is dispatched from shop.mrplus.in, you will receive an SMS and WhatsApp message with tracking details and a live courier tracking link.
